name: Kuroi Shuuichi
source:
"......Welcome. [url=/c136409]Sensei[/url]. Please take any seat you like."

The owner of the 'Kuroneko' café. 
Shuuichi has a decent rapport with the mansion's maids, who hook him up with medicine for his mom. His better half works in the city and returns around these parts during a long weekend or holiday.

Shuuichi mostly keeps to himself, not one for small talk with customers. His daughter [url=/c136407]Miyako[/url], though? The polar opposite. That's why folks say they're two sides of the same coin, so to speak.

[Translated and edited from the [url=https://escude.co.jp/product/femme_fatale/chara09.html]official website[/url]]
